name: OATS Africa FSE Theme Blocks
author: oatsafricatechsupport

sections.description:
OATS Africa FSE Theme Blocks provides the editorial Gutenberg blocks (hero, product card,
journal grid, testimonials, team grid, newsletter signup, and more) used throughout the OATS
Nova theme, along with the WooCommerce cart icon, cart drawer, and checkout shortcodes that
support it.

This plugin is designed as a companion to the OATS Nova theme. The blocks themselves will work
with any block theme, though their default styling is tuned to match OATS Nova’s editorial
visual style.

Note: the product, cart, and checkout features require WooCommerce to be active. The content
blocks (hero, journal grid, testimonials, team grid, etc.) work independently of WooCommerce.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/oats-africa-fse-theme-blocks directory,
    or install the plugin directly through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Find the blocks under the “OATS” category in the block inserter.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require the OATS Nova theme?

No. The blocks and shortcodes work with any theme, though they’re styled to match OATS Nova.

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Only for the product-related blocks and the cart/checkout shortcodes. Every other block works
without it.

default.question: What is NOVA?
default.answer: Nova is a Nigerian-born brand of scented wax charms and atmospheric objects, handpoured in Lagos. We make small batches because we want every piece to feel personal.

default.question: What are Scented Wax Charms?
default.answer: Scented Wax Charms are decorative, dual-use objects that hold fragrance. They are designed to be displayed, used as melts, or kept near you, depending on what your space needs.

default.question: Are they safe to burn?
default.answer: Yes. Our wax is plant-based and the fragrance load is calibrated for clean, even melting. Always follow the care card in your box.

default.question: How long do they last?
default.answer: Each charm carries scent for several weeks of regular use, depending on room size and ventilation. Stored properly, the scent holds for many months.

default.question: Do you ship outside Nigeria?
default.answer: Yes, we ship to select international destinations. Shipping costs are calculated at checkout based on your location.

default.question: Do you offer custom or corporate orders?
default.answer: Yes. We work on bespoke scents and corporate gifting for events, weddings and brand partnerships. Please reach out via our Custom Orders page.

default.question: What if my order arrives damaged?
default.answer: We pack everything by hand and check it twice. If something does arrive damaged, email us within 48 hours of delivery and we will make it right.

default.question: How do I care for my Scented Wax Charm?
default.answer: Keep it out of direct sunlight and away from heat. When using it as a melt, follow the dosage guide in your box for a clean, lasting throw.
